instruction: Like all the songs from the artists I follow on Spotify.
notes: The set of followed artists and their songs is unknown before runtime, so the problem uses a representative instance (2 followed artists x 2 songs); at execution the artist/song objects are instantiated from the paginated show_following_artists and search_songs responses and the like_song step is repeated per discovered song. Knowledge flow: show_following_artists reveals the followed artist ids (following-listed + static follows), show_artist reveals the artist name used as the search query, search_songs per artist reveals that artist's songs (songs-listed), and like_song can only target songs of a followed artist whose songs were listed, so no song by a non-followed artist can be liked. Because quantified goals are disallowed, the 'all songs liked' condition is encoded with a discrete counter (count objects n0..n4, next-count chain): each like_song advances the counter and supervisor-complete-task requires the counter to equal target-like-count, which, given each song can be liked at most once (not (liked ?s)), is equivalent to the explicit (liked ...) goal conjuncts. Extra non-API parameters (?ar on like-song, counter objects, ?c on complete-task) are bookkeeping only. Pagination (page_index) is handled at runtime and not modeled.
